progression: Behavior evidence at fixed cases, not update count or average reward. Unimplemented phases cannot be selected or treated as complete.

stages.goal: Body normally facing up with chassis belly on the floor and all six motors disabled, then learn physical-knee folding near40deg, move support below the COM and coordinate all six motors to rise near the starting location
stages.gate: Actual1s stable-completion event followed by30s standing, retained raw1ms contact and all later falls; measure full get-up XY excursion. One standard prone family never qualifies diverse-fall recovery.
stages.guidance: State-based reward shaping only, with no timed leg trajectory, fixed wheel program, FSM takeover or learned teacher

stages.goal: 305mm standard grounded birth; balance and30s standing
stages.gate: All declared pitch starts, full30s, no fall/body contact, v2 support and5cm excursion; repeat independent seeds and domain profiles. Mid height only is partial standing evidence.

stages.goal: Basic forward/reverse, left/right yaw, start and stop at305mm
stages.gate: Baseline evaluator is engineering screening only; straight-path, stopping and independent-seed full acceptance remain required.

stages.goal: 230/305/420mm standing, height transitions and four simultaneous translation/yaw quadrants; retainU0/U1
High forward/reverse speed, abrupt zero-command braking, both100rpm body spins with>=80rpm and spinning height changes; retain all previous tasks
Separate six-motor RL self-righting task with its own actor, critic, reward, allowed temporary body contacts, and stable-completion event
stages.forbidden: Scripted/FSM recovery, old learned donor, or using upright contact-death rules before recovery completion

stages.goal: Measured handoff after real recovery completion; genuine in-motion falls and resumption of forward/reverse/arcs/spin requests
stages.gate: One immutable final controller checkpoint/bundle containing the exact actors and handoff configuration; test the integrated behavior, never combine best subscores from different generations.

domain_sequence.applies_to: Standard-prone, every available upright stage and later recovery/integration stages
domain_sequence.discrete_timing: Use exactly the study contract; fractional amplitude strength does not continuously scale5ms policy delays
domain_sequence.population_rule: Report actual randomized and nominal sample counts. The75percent training mask cannot substitute for a fully randomized held-out test.

final_evidence.contact_start: Explicit initialized-standing start or actual logged recovery completion; never move the start past a later fall
final_evidence.unspecified_numeric_limits: Freeze engineering limits before testing and label them as engineering choices, never as user-approved thresholds

status: Standard-prone, upright foundation and domain entries implemented; advanced upright stages and new integrated campaign remain pending native behavior qualification
